comment: DOGWOOD-SHARP-D3-IMPL-01-R4 mandatory upstream differential corpus. The R3 corpus is carried forward unchanged: no fixture was removed, weakened or renamed, the ED-01 to ED-05 register rows are byte-identical, and every R3 case id is preserved. The two C-23 cases that R3 recorded as unresolved blocking gaps (R3-C23-08-ipaddr-typed-context and R3-C23-09-datetime-typed-context) are reclassified from blocking-difference to approved-difference under the owner-approved ED-06 typed-context representability ceiling, with the exact upstream and D3 observations pinned in the register and the authorized difference scope machine-enforced by the harness. Five R4 managed-control cases add the targeted C-23 semantic regression controls: valid typed ipaddr and datetime authorization, boundary behavior, invalid and malformed typed values, trusted-context binding integrity, fail-closed behavior on unexpected errors, the absence of any untrusted substitution of the caller typed value, and confirmation that the D3 Allow outcomes follow the intended CedarSharp policy semantics. Every differential case declares the exact upstream stage its observation must reach.

schemas.userDoc: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc], context: { count: Long } }; }
schemas.owner: namespace App { entity User in Group { name?: String }; entity Group; entity Doc { owner: User, secret?: Bool }; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc] }; }
schemas.groupDoc: namespace App { entity User; entity Group; entity Doc { owner: User }; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc], context: { count: Long } }; }
schemas.session: namespace App { entity Session { token: String }; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [Session], resource: [Doc] }; }
schemas.actionHierarchy: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action ReadGroup; action read2 in ReadGroup appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc] }; }
schemas.temporal: namespace Test { entity User; entity Item; action Approve appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Item], context: { input: { stock: String } } }; action Sell appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Item], context: { input: { stock: String } } }; action Audit appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Item], context: { input: { stock: String } } }; }
schemas.provider: namespace Test { entity User; entity Item; action Read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Item], context: { input: { key: String } } }; }
schemas.unicode: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc] }; }
schemas.ownerReq: namespace App { entity User { name: String }; entity Group; entity Doc { owner: User, secret?: Bool }; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc] }; }
schemas.ownerHier: namespace App { entity User in Group { name?: String }; entity Group in Group; entity Doc { owner: User, secret?: Bool }; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc] }; }
schemas.extensionDecimal: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc], context: { price: decimal } }; }
schemas.payloadDoc: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc], context: { data: String } }; }
schemas.extensionIpaddr: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc], context: { ip: ipaddr } }; }
schemas.extensionDatetime: namespace App { entity User; entity Doc; action read appliesTo { principal: [User], resource: [Doc], context: { ts: datetime } }; }

C-14.exemptionReason: temporal-failure semantics are inherently negative; positive temporal coverage is mandatory in C-12 and C-13

C-15.exemptionReason: the reserved generated field is a D3 trusted-pipeline concept with no upstream counterpart

C-21.exemptionReason: identity mapping is a D3 export concept; upstream determining identity is differentially observed in every evaluation-stage case

C-22.exemptionReason: schema transport forms are a D3 export concept; the canonical schema is differentially observed by the C-11 canonical-schema case

C-25.exemptionReason: concurrency isolation is a D3 runtime property; single-threaded equivalence is differentially observed in every evaluation-stage case

C-26.exemptionReason: native/lifecycle semantics are inherently negative; process-lifetime residency is verified by the executed resident lifecycle scenario

cases.approvedDifferenceReason: The pinned upstream Dogwood 1.1.2 value model has no ipaddr variant, so a typed ipaddr context value cannot reach the upstream authorizer as a typed value and the upstream comparison is a clean Deny, while D3 evaluates the Cedar ip extension through CedarSharp and reaches a clean Allow. The owner approved exactly this representability ceiling as ED-06 for this case and for R3-C23-09-datetime-typed-context, with the authorized difference scope limited to the decision, determining and cleanAllow fields.
